name: Planora
brief: A wedding planning platform that organizes bookings, budgets, tasks and vendor communication in one connected experience.

content.p: Planora was created to reduce the complexity of wedding planning by placing the main planning activities inside one organized system.
Wedding planning often involves many disconnected notes, calls, chats and spreadsheets. Planora brings those activities together so users can follow the event from planning to completion.

content.description: The web and mobile parts are designed around the same planning workflow so users can continue their work across devices.

ul: HTML, CSS and JavaScript for the web interface
Java and Android for mobile functionality
